answer.rationale: With 14 days to expiry, no auto-renew, and the line at 94% of committed volume, switching primary vendors or deferring creates avoidable delivery risk; adding a second source improves resilience but is unlikely to deliver the mandated 18% in-cycle and may raise near-term TCO. I intend to renegotiate with the incumbent using market benchmarking and a longer-term/volume structure to seek price and payment-term relief while preserving integration and delivery continuity. Verify memory_c4 and memory_c6 because they are the main evidence that renewal negotiation and multi-year commitment can recover margin without narrowing service scope.
